sources.title: 'IN THE WEIGHTS' shows how strongly a person's 'name' is weighted ...
sources.snippet: 'IN THE WEIGHTS' is a service that shows how strongly the 'names' of various people, such as historical figures, celebrities, and athletes, are weighted within the AI model.

sources.title: Website "In the Weights" shows whether AI models know who you are
sources.snippet: Those "weights" are billions of numerical values where AI models encode their knowledge. If you show up in them, the model considered you relevant enough during training to recall without tools like web search. The site queries several models to figure out who a specific person is, combines the results, and assigns a strength score.
